tanukiHelpsReadFromSources: Tanuki is an application for finding and reading manga from independent source websites. It helps you organize bookmarks, save reading progress, transfer your library and download chapters to your device for offline reading.
termsApplyToThisInstance: These terms apply to the Tanuki instance at the current address. It is run by the administrator whose contact details appear below. By registering, you accept the terms of use; data processing is described in a separate policy.
registrationByInvitation: Registration requires an invitation. An account requires a username, password and verified email address. Email is used to confirm actions, restore access and send account security messages.
keepAccountAccessSecure: Use your own email address and keep your password, recovery links and invitations secure. Do not share account access with others. If you suspect unauthorized access, change your password and end other sessions in your profile.
contentBelongsToRightsHolders: Works, translations, descriptions and images belong to their respective rights holders. Tanuki does not own the source websites or grant rights to their materials. Content is requested from sources through the application server; temporary caching and local downloads do not change ownership of those rights.
useContentWithinApplicableRules: Use materials only as permitted by applicable law and the source website’s rules. The ability to open or download a chapter does not in itself authorize redistribution. If you are a rights holder reporting an infringement, send the administrator links to the material and information supporting your rights.
adultContentRequiresAgeConfirmation: Some sources contain adult material. Adult sources and titles are hidden by default; they can be enabled in settings after confirming that you are at least 18. Do not enable them if you are under 18 or access is prohibited in your country. Age ratings come from sources and may be inaccurate.
doNotDisruptServiceOrAccessOthersData: Do not attempt to access other people’s accounts or data, bypass access restrictions, disrupt the application or place excessive load on the server or sources. Do not use the service to infringe others’ rights or violate applicable law.
accessMayBeRestrictedForAbuse: The administrator may restrict or block access for violations of these rules or threats to service security. Contact the administrator if you believe a restriction was applied in error.
availabilityDependsOnSources: The service is provided as is. Individual features depend on source availability, the network and your browser. Materials may change or disappear; uninterrupted operation, catalog completeness and source data accuracy are not guaranteed. These terms do not limit user rights or liability that cannot be excluded by law.
keepYourOwnLibraryBackup: Periodically create a library backup in the Data section of your profile and keep it somewhere safe. Your browser may remove local downloads when data is cleared or storage runs low. A library backup does not contain downloaded chapter images.
youCanDeleteYourAccount: You can stop using the service and request account deletion in your profile. Deletion is scheduled after a 14-day grace period; you can cancel before the stated date using the email link or when signing in. Data retention and deletion are described in the data processing policy.
currentTermsPublishedHere: The current terms are published on this page with a revision date. If you do not agree with new terms, stop using the service; you can save a library backup before deleting your account.
instanceAdministratorProcessesData: Data for this Tanuki instance is processed by its administrator. Contact details appear at the end of this document. This policy applies to the application at the current address; other Tanuki instances may have different administrators and data processing practices.
dataUsedToProvideService: Data is used to create your account and provide the service under the terms of use: signing in, syncing your library and settings, reading statistics, imports, notifications and abuse prevention. Connecting source accounts and enabling push notifications are optional. Data is not used for advertising profiling.
storedAccountData: Account data includes your username, email address and verification status, password hash, avatar, role, language, registration and last activity dates, and invitation, restriction or deletion request details. Your Tanuki password is not stored in plain text.
storedLibraryAndActivity: Usage data includes bookmarks and folders, search history, reading positions and completed chapters, reading time and statistics, interface, source and reader settings, time zone, adult age confirmation, notifications and import progress. This data preserves your actions and lets you continue reading on other devices.
storedSecurityData: Sessions store a sign-in token hash, IP address, browser and device information, creation and last activity times, and expiry time. For push notifications, the subscription endpoint and delivery keys are stored. The server keeps technical request and error logs, which may contain IP addresses and requested resource addresses.
sourceCredentialsStoredEncrypted: If you connect a source website account, the server receives the sign-in details you enter or the cookies and tokens you transfer. The account name is stored for display in settings, while cookies and tokens are stored encrypted for requests on your behalf. A source password is stored encrypted only if you allow automatic sign-in.
disconnectSourceToRemoveCredentials: The connection is used to access materials through your account and import source bookmarks. You can disconnect it in source settings to remove the connection data stored by Tanuki. This does not delete your account on the source website.
sessionCookiePurposeAndLifetime: Signing in uses the essential tanuki_session cookie. Without Remember me, it is a browser session cookie and the server session expires after one day of inactivity. With Remember me, the lifetime is 30 days and is renewed with activity. Signing out ends the current session; you can end other sessions in your profile.
localStorageAndOfflineData: Your browser stores settings, information for offline access, cached responses and images, downloaded chapters and the download queue in device storage and a local database. This enables offline use and preserves settings. You can remove downloads in the application and all local data in browser settings. Clearing local data does not delete your server account.
administratorAccessAndNoAdvertising: Your account and library are not published to all users. The administrator and authorized staff have access as needed for support, account management and security. The server administrator has the technical ability to access stored data. Data is not sold or shared with advertising networks.
externalServicesReceiveNecessaryData: Source websites receive content requests and authentication data if you have connected an account. When you visit a source directly, it also receives standard browser information. The email provider receives your address and message content to deliver service emails; if push is enabled, the browser’s push service delivers encrypted notifications. These external services operate under their own policies and may be located in other countries.
dataKeptWhileAccountExists: Account and library data is retained while your account exists or until you delete records that can be removed individually. Expired sessions and one-time codes are cleaned up automatically. An account with an unverified email is removed during scheduled cleanup after 7 days. Notifications older than 30 days are also cleaned up automatically.
accountDeletedAfterGracePeriod: You can request account deletion in your profile by confirming your password. All sessions end immediately. After 14 days, the account and associated personal data are removed during the next scheduled cleanup; you can cancel before the deadline using the email link or when signing in. Invitation records may remain without a link to the deleted account.
deviceCopiesAndServerBackups: Deleting your account does not erase backup files you downloaded or local data on other devices; remove these separately. Retention periods for technical logs and server backups depend on this instance’s configuration; you can ask the administrator for details. Deletion from the active database does not mean immediate erasure from those copies.
manageAndExportYourData: In your profile you can change your username, email, password and avatar, view and end sessions, create a library backup and request account deletion. A library backup transfers your library and settings but is not a complete export of all personal data. You can clear search history and disable saving it, and turn off push notifications in settings.
requestDataAccessCorrectionOrDeletion: Contact the administrator to request information about processing, access to your data, correction or deletion, or to withdraw consent where processing relies on it. Include your account name and request; account ownership may need to be verified to prevent unauthorized requests. Do not send passwords or sign-in codes.
currentPolicyPublishedHere: The current policy is published on this page with a revision date. It is updated when the data collected, processing purposes or services used change. You can ask the administrator about the current policy.
contactAdministratorAboutDataOrContent: For questions about the service, data processing or rights to materials, contact the administrator by email or Telegram.
